Night of the Long Knives | Operation Hummingbird | Rohm Purge
# 1934's Night of the Long Knives: Hitler, seeking absolute power, orchestrated a bloody purge against his own party members.
# The Targets: He eliminated his former allies in the SA (Sturmabteilung) or "Brownshirts," a large paramilitary group led by Ernst Röhm.
# The Reason: The military saw the SA as a threat, and Röhm's ambition to merge his forces with the regular army challenged Hitler's authority.
